header.title: Flicker
header.description: Neon tube flicker: a colored halo behind the content that switches on and off in steps. `variant` sets the pattern (`neon`, `buzz`, `strobe`, `fault` or `text`), `edge` limits it to one side and `trigger` decides when it runs. By default it flickers all the time.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. With `hover` or `click` the halo only shows while active.
playground.label: Open

sign.title: Neon sign
sign.description: With the defaults (`variant="neon"`, `trigger="always"`) the halo stays on most of the time and drops three times per `2800ms` cycle. The content goes down to 42% opacity on each drop. The halo inherits the root `border-radius`, so set one there.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `neon` drops now and then, `buzz` hums with short dips and barely goes out, `strobe` alternates on and off in equal halves (here with `900ms`), `fault` stays off most of the cycle with sparks (here with `4200ms`) and `text` flickers the text's `text-shadow` instead of the halo.

edge.title: Edge
edge.description: With an `edge` other than `all`, the halo becomes a strip against that side, a `3px` tube shows up and the content stops dimming. `x` lights left and right; `y`, top and bottom. `spread` sets the strip thickness.

text.title: Text
text.description: `variant="text"` draws no halo or tube: it tints the text with `color` and animates its `text-shadow`. Works best with large, bold text.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover`, the halo shows when the pointer is over it or when the keyboard reaches the root or something inside (`:focus-visible`). With `click`, each click turns it on or off. At rest there's no halo and the content stays at 100%.

spread.title: Spread
spread.description: `spread` is how far the halo extends past the box (or the strip thickness with `edge`). A number is pixels; a string is used as is (`"1rem"`). Default `18`.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is the length of one full pattern cycle, in milliseconds. `delay` postpones the start, handy to offset several signs.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` is the halo's maximum opacity; the tube uses 55% of it. Takes a token (`sm`, `md`, `lg`) or a number between `0` and `1`.

color.title: Color
color.description: `color` takes any CSS color, variables included. Without `color`, it uses `--gem-palette-primary-400`.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild` the effect mounts on the child, with no wrapping `div`: useful inside text or a link, where a `div` isn't valid. The child is root and surface at once: with `text` it gets the color and the `text-shadow`, and with the other variants the halo sits behind its content (`z-index: -1`). The content doesn't dim with the flicker; only the halo flickers. If the child can't hold content (`img`, `input`), the effect wraps it in a `div` again.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the flicker on the current step. `isDisabled` removes the halo and leaves the content at 100% and interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onFlicker` fires when the effect turns on and `outFlicker` when it turns off, with the reason in `event.reason`. The halo stays behind and doesn't block clicks.

texts.body: Hover the card to light the tube and click the button.

header.title: Flicker API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Flicker`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for every variant, edge, trigger and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/flicker` along with its `flicker.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> attributes (except color, which is its own prop) and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). onClick, onPointerEnter and onPointerLeave run before the effect's internal logic.

items.photosensitivity: This is a flashing effect. To meet WCAG 2.3.1, avoid more than three flashes per second: don't lower duration too much, especially with strobe and fault, and don't use it over large areas of the screen.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the animation stops: the halo and tube stay still at a lower opacity, the content at 100%, and text keeps a static shadow while it's on. When off (isActive={false}, isDisabled or a resting hover / click) it has no glow, same as without reduced motion. These rules don't use !important: no animation rule beats them, but a more specific class of yours does.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the flicker. Use it only when essential.
items.decorative: The halo layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it isn't announced and doesn't block clicks.
items.keyboard: With trigger="hover" the halo also shows with keyboard focus on the root or inside (:focus-visible); a mouse click that focuses a button doesn't keep it on. onFlicker only fires with the pointer.
items.click: With trigger="click" the toggle listens to the root's click. If the child is a button, it also responds to Enter and Space.

items.root: Root. `position: relative`, `inline-flex` and `isolation: isolate`. It animates `--gemfx-flicker-gate`.
items.edge: Added when `edge` isn't `all`. Turns the halo into a strip, shows the tube and keeps the content at 100%.
items.trigger: Added with `trigger="hover"` or `"click"` (there's no class for `always`).
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}` or `isDisabled`. Removes the animation, the halo and the tube; with `text`, the color and the `text-shadow` (also under reduced motion).
items.layer: Decorative layer behind the content (`aria-hidden`, `z-index: 0`; `-1` with `asChild`, to sit below the child's content).
items.halo: Blurred glow. The `-alt` versions only exist with `edge="x"` or `"y"`.
items.tube: Tube tint over the whole box, or the `3px` line with `edge`. The `-alt` versions only exist with `edge="x"` or `"y"`.
items.surface: Wraps the child. Its opacity follows the flicker (except with `edge`) and with `text` it gets the color. With `asChild` it's the child itself: it gets the `text` color, but its opacity doesn't change.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `duration`, `delay`, `spread` and `intensity` are written inline on every render, so you can only change them through the props. `--gemfx-flicker-color` is inline only when you pass `color`; otherwise you can override it from a class, just like `--gemfx-flicker-blur`.

items.color: Color of the halo, tube and text. Set by `color`; default `var(--gem-palette-primary-400)`.
items.blur: Halo blur. No prop: change it from a class. Default `1.1rem`.
items.duration: Length of one cycle. Set by `duration`; default `2800ms`.
items.spread: Halo extent (or strip thickness with `edge`). Set by `spread`; default `18px`.
items.intensity: Halo maximum opacity, as a percentage. Set by `intensity`: `sm` 35%, `md` 55%, `lg` 80%, or the number × 100.
items.gate: Instant brightness between `0` and `1`, animated with `steps(1, end)`. It's a registered property: don't override it, read it if you want to sync other parts with the flicker.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Flicker reads as defaults.

items.intensityMd: CSS fallback value. Unused in practice: `intensity` always writes the percentage inline, so redefining the token changes nothing.
items.palette: gem-system default color. If it isn't loaded, falls back to `#2ee6c6`.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content gets lit and where the effect mounts.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Pattern, edge, color, spread and intensity of the halo.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Pattern cycle and delay, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it runs and how it pauses or turns off.

items.children: Content the halo is drawn around.
items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, with no wrapping `div`. The halo sits behind the child's content, `text` and `edge` work the same and the content doesn't dim. If the child can't hold content (`img`, `input`), it falls back to a `div`.
items.variant: `neon` occasional drops, `buzz` hum with short dips, `strobe` on and off in halves, `fault` mostly off with sparks, `text` flickering `text-shadow`.
items.edge: `all` lights the whole box. A side (`top`, `right`, `bottom`, `left`) or an axis (`x`, `y`) turns the halo into a strip and adds a `3px` tube.
items.color: Neon color. Any CSS color; without a value it uses `--gem-palette-primary-400`.
items.spread: Halo extent. A number is pixels (negatives become `0`); a string is used as is. An empty string falls back to `18px`.
items.intensity: Halo maximum opacity. Token or number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: Length of one pattern cycle. Negatives become `0`.
items.trigger: `always` flickers all the time, `hover` while the pointer is over it or there's keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) on the root or inside, `click` toggles on each click.
items.isActive: Allows the effect. When `false` it removes the halo and `outFlicker` gets `inactive`.
items.isPaused: Freezes the flicker on the current step.
items.isDisabled: Stops the effect; the child stays at 100% and interactive. `outFlicker` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Flickers even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only when essential.
items.onFlicker: Fires when the effect turns on: on mount with `always`, when the pointer enters or when toggled on by click.
items.outFlicker: Fires when it turns off: when the pointer leaves, when toggled off by click, when deactivated or on unmount.
items.style: Root inline styles. Merged with the `--gemfx-flicker-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
